description: This file defines a class SNWebCrypto that provides cryptographic functionalities such as encryption, decryption, hashing, key generation, and OTP/HOTP/TOTP token generation, integrating WebCrypto API and libsodium.

classes.name: SNWebCrypto
classes.description: A class providing cryptographic operations using WebCrypto API and libsodium, including encryption, hashing, key derivation, and OTP generation.

methods.description: Initializes the crypto instance, awaiting libsodium readiness.

methods.description: Deinitializes the crypto instance.
